svg.aria-label: Daily units of bottled water at the depot from July 2022 to June 2026, as a thin pale line, with a 28-day rolling average as a thick line. The rolling average shows slow growth and a peak each December; the daily line shows the weekly ups and downs and closed days at zero.
svg.title: Bottled water, daily units with a 28-day rolling average: trend and a December peak each year.

g.text: Pale: each day (weekday swings, zeros on closed days). Dark: 28-day rolling average (trend and season).
